title: Petr Menhart — red brush lettering on warm grey, star-separated services
note: A single centred poster of a page on warm grey #E1DEDB. A black dry-brush drawing (a flat bowl or hat, smudgy edges) sits on top with a small red six-point star in its middle; under it "petr menhart" in his own red (#F42828) hand lettering, uncial-like with mixed caps, about 80px. Then the services as a centred two-line list in a bold 20px grotesk (-1.5px tracking): event flyers ✦ movie posters ✦ visual identity ✦ publications ✦ advertising ✦ photography & video ✦ personal artworks ✦ tattoo, each separated by a red star. Hovering one turns it red. A tiny justified bio and red email/Instagram links close it. Built in Readymag, fonts "Austin" and a custom grotesk. Worth reusing: one hand-made wordmark in one bright colour, and the services list doubling as nav.
